name: smwmusic-mario-is-missing-nes-expanded-berlin-germany
title: Mario is Missing! (NES) Expanded - Berlin Germany
description:
Ever wondered what the music would sound like if Mario is Missing! for the NES was ever expanded upon?
Well, I certainly was and the result was this!

It's a pretty neato composition I'd say, it captures some stuff from the original and turns it into something new.
The percussion is a bit of unhinged compered to how it is in the actual game, but I think it has a certain charm to it that compliments the song well.

Will I end up doing more?
Certainly, but not actively, maybe once a couple months.

Anyway, this song can be used in retro levels and cities.
It can be a bit repetitive after a while, so keep that in mind!
